verdict.rationale: Relay documents its own recurring automation: recurring invoices on the pricing page, plus auto-transfer rules that split deposits by dollar amount or percentage and sweep excess cash into savings. Most of these rules are triggered by deposits rather than by a user-defined schedule, and a community user notes external payments still have to be executed manually. That limits this to narrow, finance-specific recurrence rather than general scheduling of jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: user-defined time-based scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows, scheduled recurring bill payments or transfers, programmatic/API scheduling for AI-native use, independent hands-on corroboration of recurring features.
